AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-08-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Helen Holt-Smith.
Petitioner: Maria Yanez, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Angel Yanez, and with Spanish Interpreter: Sandra Ramirez.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the Minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Luis Angel Romero Yanez.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
